images.title: Three area rules
images.purpose: A clean summary of three area formulas, each tied to its shape and perpendicular height.
images.composition: Three shapes in one row, evenly spaced, each with its formula underneath.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, lots of empty space, the figure large and centred, thin dark outlines. Only the labels listed appear; no other text, no scenery, no characters. LEFT: a triangle with a horizontal base, filled teal (#0072B2). MIDDLE: a parallelogram leaning right with a horizontal base, filled amber (#E69F00). RIGHT: a trapezium with horizontal parallel sides, the top shorter than the bottom, filled reddish purple (#CC79A7). Each shape has one grey (#6B7280) dashed vertical height from its top down to its base with a small right angle mark. All three shapes are the same height. Under each shape, its name and formula on two lines: Triangle, 1/2 × b × h; Parallelogram, b × h; Trapezium, 1/2 × h × (a + b).
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each area rule uses a height perpendicular to the base.
images.description: A clean summary of three area formulas, each tied to its shape and perpendicular height.
images.context: Chapter summary. Rhombus and polygon rules are carried by the recap video.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the child to say how each shape comes from a rectangle or triangle.

image_decisions.why: A recap benefits from a three item visual summary linking each shape to its rule.
